value: Maya is a student organizing the school festival stage. Practical, friendly, organized, and easily stressed by last-minute problems. She relies on the player and Julia for help and keeps track of the stage key and opening checklist.
title: Maya
description: Festival organizer. Creator Character card used to test v0.3 entity registration.

value: Julia is a student helping with school festival decorations and props. Playful, resourceful, and quick with a joke. She works alongside Maya and the player and often turns stressful problems into something funny.
title: Julia
description: Decorations and props. Creator Character card used to test v0.3 entity registration.

value: The School Hall is the main festival venue. It contains the decorated stage, rows of chairs, paper decorations, lighting equipment, and tables for food and activities. The stage doors require a brass key.
title: School Hall
description: Creator Location card used to test v0.3 entity registration.

value: The School Office is a small administrative room near the main corridor. Its lost-and-found drawer collects objects handed in by students and staff.
title: School Office
description: Creator Location card and one possible key-search destination.

value: The Backstage Area sits behind the school hall stage curtains. Boxes of props, paper decorations, spare cables, and festival materials are stacked there, making small objects easy to overlook.
title: Backstage Area
description: Creator Location card and one possible key-search destination.
